scope: Focused review of the reported radar fracture, runner phase continuity, and four restarted animal loops. File measurements and runtime frame coverage are separate observations.
method: Inspect complete native frame sequences, integer-magnified affected details, adjacent phases and the last-to-first boundary; compare final GIF-decoded frames and declared timing with the reviewed source exports.
limits: These are short README animation examples. Transitions between gameplay states and player-controlled motion were not implemented.
Visual observations describe the inspected revisions and do not turn alpha, frame-count, or source-fidelity measurements into an aesthetic score.

assets.examined: All eight native joint crops at 12x, all eight actual GIF-decoded joint crops, a full-frame extreme, and the 7-to-0 boundary. Region: x238,y64,width48,height34 on the 384x256 source.
observations: The prior rectangular cut crossed the support. The revised complete tapered mast and collar remain fixed while the dish changes pitch.
Native per-pose socket and material retouch removes the visible horizontal notch. No remaining reported fracture was found in the inspected poses.
The GIF has eight 250ms frames, totaling two seconds. Joint appearance was reviewed independently of the cold source/export comparison.

assets.examined: All eight full native poses and 6x upper-body chronological crops, including 1-to-2,4-to-5 and 7-to-0, followed by the complete decoded final GIF contact sheet. Final GIF is reencoded from the post-arm-edit exports.
observations: The near leg advances through contact, compression, push, folded recovery and forward reach; the torso no longer swaps to a back view midway through the sequence.

The previous same-arm-stays-behind defect remained in an intermediate candidate and was rejected. The final near sleeve visibly crosses in front of the chest in poses2/3/4, with the far sleeve recessed behind it.
Poses1/5 have similar passing silhouettes below the hip, traveling in opposite temporal directions. This similarity is retained rather than misreported as eight completely different key actions.
The face, hair and earpiece are preserved as a consistent native layer. The costume is an updated generated variant, as recorded beside the source.

assets.examined: All eight complete native poses, all eight 6x foot crops, the actual final decoded GIF contact sheet, and the 7-to-0 boundary.
observations: New generated reference and new draft replace the previous animal design; the recognizable spatulate bill, full head, patterned wing, tail and rounded belly remain complete.
Two connected legs exchange forward support, backward stance and lifted recovery through the cycle; the supporting foot keeps its baseline. The previous second-row body jump is gone.
The earlier filled triangular feet were rejected. Final native pixels show narrow toe branches with transparent gaps, and the recovery toes fold rather than retaining a flat filled paddle.

assets.examined: All eight complete native poses, magnified actual foot crops2-to-5, the actual final decoded GIF contact sheet, and the 7-to-0 boundary.
observations: The new reference design retains the complete crest, cheek patch, beak, red vent, tail and both wing roots.
The loop proceeds from standing to crouch, release, airborne wing motion, tucked feet, extended landing feet, landing compression and recovery.

Planted poses0/1/6/7 share the corrected ground baseline. The toes remain attached while tucked in3/4 and extend before landing. No concrete remaining reported transition break was found in this reviewed short loop.

assets.examined: All eight complete native poses, 6x root/paw crops0/1, actual saved-layer ownership diagnostic, transition pairs0-to-1,3-to-4,5-to-6,7-to-0, and all eight actual final GIF-decoded frames.
observations: The new generated design supplies the retained fur, head, body and tail pixels. Rejected generated motion studies are recorded as rejected; the selected native animation articulates textured limbs rather than importing those studies as final frames.

The near hind leg advances, travels backward in stance and lifts for recovery; the other legs use offset contact phases. Actual layer inspection distinguishes temporarily occluded far-hind toes from a missing limb.
Fixed fur rows at each root remove the prior scaling seam. The connected muzzle whiskers replace isolated white specks, and toe/foreground overlap contours were retouched natively.
The calm head and torso are intentional in this short stylized walk. Far-foot and near-foot baselines differ with the adopted depth; equal screen-space y was not imposed as a universal contact rule.

assets.examined: All eight complete final native poses, 8x paw crops0/2/7 and neck crop4, the full final GIF-decoded contact sheet, and the 7-to-0 boundary.
observations: A new reference and explicit native limb-ownership guide produced complementary leg arrangements. The near hind leg now recovers and plants forward under the body instead of remaining permanently behind the hip.

The selected sequence advances through one diagonal support phase, recovery, complementary precontact/plant, stance and return. Pose3 deliberately uses a slightly lifted precontact hold of pose4; the record identifies seven selected generated body poses rather than inventing eight independent generated key poses.

Native retouching stabilizes the recognizable head and finishes distal fur/paw contacts in the locally chosen side-profile support convention. The inspected roots, neck boundary and paw contours have no open fracture.
The final GIF preserves the inspected frame order and complete silhouette, with a one-second loop and integer nearest-neighbor enlargement.
